text: Meet Hidento. An integrated platform for dental labs, their doctors, and the dental technician community.
Most labs run on separate tools that don't talk to each other. Hidento puts the lab, its doctors, and its technicians on one platform, in Arabic and English.
The lab ERP runs the whole day. Cases and production stages, technician performance, multi-country tax invoices, doctor accounts with debt aging, inventory, staff, and branches.
Doctors get their own portal. They send and track cases, approve designs in a 3D viewer, and see their balance and monthly statements.
There is also a smile designer. It finds the mouth automatically, places realistic new teeth, and lets the doctor adjust every tooth by touch, with a before and after image for the patient.
DentoMedia is a professional network and freelance marketplace for dental technicians, with messaging, voice and video calls, ads, and paid verification.

Recent additions include a live demo anyone can try in one click, Excel import, and automations. A weekly report for the owner, payment reminders to doctors, alerts for stuck cases, and monthly statements.
It is built on React, TypeScript, and Convex. About fifty three thousand lines of code, two hundred and ninety nine automated tests, and four security reviews with every finding fixed.

Revenue streams are already built in. Lab subscriptions at one hundred forty nine dollars a month, the smile designer for doctors, ads, verification, and a marketplace fee, with payments through Paddle.

To be transparent, Hidento is pre-revenue, with no paying customers yet. It is substantially developed, and the remaining finishing touches depend on the buyer's market. Building it from scratch would take a team of four about twelve to fifteen months.
Hidento is available for full acquisition, including the source code, the IP, and the documentation. Try the live demo, and get in touch.
